description: Defines an abstract class DownloadFormat for handling different download formats related to employee data in the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods for generating download filenames based on employee information and retrieving the employee service.

classes.name: DownloadFormat
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a template for various download formats, including methods for filename generation and access to employee data.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to return a formatted string based on provided values.

methods.name: getDownloadFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for downloading an employee's data, appending '(Past Employee)' if applicable, and using the employee's full name.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeService used to retrieve employee data.
